title: AutoCAD Design Engineer
description:
**Company:** Syama Dynamic Integrated Services Pvt. Ltd.  
**Department:** Pre\-Sales / Design \& Engineering  
**Designation:** AutoCAD Design Engineer  
**Experience:** 1–3 Years  
**Location:** Kerala  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Reporting To:** Project Manager

1\. Job Summary

We are looking for a skilled and detail\-oriented **AutoCAD Design Engineer** to prepare technical drawings, layouts, schematics, and documentation for ELV, IT infrastructure, electrical, and related projects.

The candidate will work closely with the Pre\-Sales, Project Execution, Purchase, and Sales teams to convert project requirements into accurate and practical engineering drawings.

2\. Key Responsibilities

* Prepare detailed **2D AutoCAD drawings, layouts, schematics, and technical drawings** based on project requirements.
* Prepare drawings for **ELV and IT infrastructure systems**, including:
* CCTV
* Fire Alarm System (FAS)
* Structured Cabling \& Networking
* Access Control
* Public Address System
* Video Conferencing
* Data \& Voice Systems
* Other ELV systems as required
* Prepare **electrical layouts, cable routing, equipment layouts, and related drawings** wherever required.
* Develop floor plans, equipment layouts, rack layouts, cable pathways, termination details, and installation drawings.
* Prepare **as\-built drawings** based on actual site installations.
* Review architectural drawings and identify design requirements, constraints, and coordination requirements.
* Incorporate revisions and modifications based on client, consultant, and project\-team requirements.
* Coordinate with the **Pre\-Sales and Project Execution teams** to ensure drawings are technically accurate and practical for execution.
* Conduct site visits when required to collect measurements and understand existing site conditions.
* Ensure proper identification, numbering, dimensions, legends, symbols, and annotations in drawings.
* Prepare drawing revisions and maintain proper **drawing version control and documentation**.
* Assist the Pre\-Sales team with drawings required for quotations, tenders, BOQs, and technical submissions.
* Review drawings before submission to ensure accuracy and compliance with project requirements.
* Coordinate with project engineers, supervisors, technicians, and other stakeholders during execution.
* Maintain a systematic record of approved, revised, and as\-built drawings.
* Ensure drawings are prepared according to company standards, project specifications, and applicable requirements.
* Support the team in resolving drawing\-related technical issues during project execution.

3\. Required Skills \& Qualifications

* Diploma / B.Tech / B.E. in **Civil, Electrical, Electronics, or related engineering discipline**.
* Minimum **1–3 years of experience** in AutoCAD drafting/design, preferably in ELV, electrical, MEP, IT infrastructure, or similar projects.
* Strong working knowledge of **AutoCAD 2D**.
* Knowledge of preparing technical layouts, schematics, and engineering drawings.
* Good understanding of **ELV systems, electrical layouts, networking, and site installations** will be an advantage.
* Ability to read and interpret architectural, electrical, and engineering drawings.
* Good knowledge of drawing standards, dimensions, symbols, layers, blocks, and annotation.
* Knowledge of **MS Office**, particularly Excel and Word.
* Ability to understand project requirements and convert them into accurate drawings.
* Good attention to detail and accuracy.
* Good communication and coordination skills.

4\. Preferred Skills

* Experience in **ELV / MEP / Electrical / IT Infrastructure projects**.
* Knowledge of CCTV, Fire Alarm, Access Control, Networking, Structured Cabling, and other ELV systems.
* Knowledge of **AutoCAD blocks, templates, layers, XREFs, and drawing standards**.
* Knowledge of preparing BOQ\-related drawings and technical submissions.
* Familiarity with **Revit / SketchUp / other design software** will be an added advantage.
* Experience in preparing **as\-built drawings**.
* Willingness to travel to project sites when required.

5\. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Accuracy and quality of drawings.
* Timely completion and submission of drawings.
* Compliance with project specifications and company drawing standards.
* Timely completion of as\-built drawings.
* Coordination effectiveness with Pre\-Sales and Project Execution teams.
* Proper maintenance of drawing records and revision history.
* Responsiveness to project and site requirements.

6\. Personal Attributes

* Detail\-oriented and organized.
* Good analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently as well as in a team.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
* Willingness to learn new technologies and systems.
* Professional attitude and good communication skills.
* Strong sense of responsibility and ownership.

Pay: ₹2,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Commuter assistance
* Health insurance
* Internet reimbursement
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Vyttila, Kochi, Kerala
